evidence.title: Beautiful UI — Crafted primitives for AI-native interfaces

name: Ice Cream Harness
summary: Interactive chat demo built from Beautiful UI primitives: ask a question and watch the agent think, stream and answer.
description: An interactive chat window assembled from Beautiful UI primitives: ask a question and watch the agent think, stream, and build the answer out of live components. A demo of the component library for AI-native interfaces; the page renders client-side, so only its title and description were readable.
